newsitem.title: USA: Clear Channel stock rises after Q2.
newsitem.headline: Clear Channel stock rises after Q2.

text.p: Clear Channel Communications Inc shares jumped in early trading after the company posted stronger-than-expected second quarter profits.
The stock was up 2-5/8 to 66-1/4, a new year high.
Lehman analyst Tim Wallace said in a research report that after-tax cash flow for the second quarter was $0.59, beating his estimate of $0.55, and up 75 percent from $0.34 last year.
Strong ad sales and acquisitions added to the strong cash flow results, he said.
The San Antonio, Texas company, which held a conference call this morning, was not immediately available for comment.
